description: My Market News is the data service of USDA Market News, part of the Agricultural Marketing Service, which reports prices, volumes and conditions for US farm commodity markets. The pages read on 2026-09-28 describe market information on hundreds of agricultural commodities and related products, provided free of charge to everyone, grouped into cotton, dairy, livestock, specialty crops and tobacco. A public data page lets anyone select a report by commodity, office or market type, choose a report section and date range and retrieve the data, and an interface for programs (MARS) returns the raw data behind published reports in bulk, with guides for loading it into spreadsheets. Coverage is United States commodity markets. Access is free; the web query needs no account, while the API needs a free government login and a personal key, and no licence is stated. Caveats: each report has its own fields and schedule, and the report catalogue itself was not browsed. It supports food supply resilience and flow studies, such as tracking terminal market prices and shipments of fresh produce during a drought or transport disruption. Related records: the USDA recall API and Canada's weekly grain statistics.
